results.title: Fictional Bright Smile Dental - DHA Phase 5, Lahore
results.snippet: Fictional Bright Smile Dental is a family dental clinic in DHA Phase 5, Lahore, offering braces, implants and teeth whitening. Open six days a week.

results.title: Bright Smile Dental opens second room
results.snippet: The clinic added a second treatment room this year and takes appointments by phone and walk-in only.
